name: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded or Download Cradle Execution
description: Identifies PowerShell script block logging events containing obfuscated base64 encoded commands or web download cradles.
expected_signal: Living-off-the-land execution of in-memory payloads or remote stage downloads.

logic.query_template: index=endpoint sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" EventCode=4104 (ScriptBlockText="*-EncodedCommand*" OR ScriptBlockText="*DownloadString*" OR ScriptBlockText="*IEX*" OR ScriptBlockText="*Invoke-Expression*")
